image_description: A street scene featuring a green metal pole with multiple traffic signal heads attached. The primary subject is a vertical traffic light assembly with three circular lenses; the top lens is illuminated amber/yellow, while the middle and bottom are dark. To the left, another signal head faces away or sideways. In the background, there is a white multi-story building with windows and bare trees against an overcast sky. A banner hangs from the pole below the main light.

artifact_observations.location: Background building windows and tree branches
artifact_observations.reasoning: The windows on the white building in the background show slight irregularity and 'melting' patterns typical of AI generation. Tree branches in the upper right exhibit some fuzzy, indistinct endings rather than sharp natural tapering.
The text on the white banner ('...er ...strasse') is illegible and distorted. The characters do not form coherent words and appear warped, a common artifact in AI-generated scenes with text.
The horizontal arm holding the secondary traffic light on the left seems to merge slightly ambiguously with the main pole and the background. The connection point lacks clear mechanical definition.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a traffic light and not a similar looking object (e.g., street lamp).
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and structural integrity of the text on the banner, which showed signs of gibberish.
To check for edge bleeding between the black housing and the green pole, ensuring they are distinct physical objects.
To assess the severity of the texture anomalies in the building and trees identified in the initial scan.

focus_areas: Legibility of text on the banner
Sharpness of boundaries between the traffic light housing and the pole
Structural plausibility of the mounting brackets
Consistency of lighting on the lenses (amber glow vs. ambient light)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the banner; if it is completely nonsensical, this is a strong indicator of AI generation despite the realistic appearance of the main subject. Also, verify if the 'amber' light has a realistic glow effect or if it looks like a flat yellow circle pasted on.
